children: Kinetiq has a KNTQ supply unlock set for September 2027. The unlock covers tokens allocated to investors and team members. At least 12.92 million KNTQ is due to unlock. That amount is equal to 3.57% of the circulating supply.
Once the tokens unlock, recipients can put them up for sale. If investors or team members sell any of those tokens, the added supply on the market could increase sell pressure on KNTQ.

title: Kinetiq: KNTQ supply unlock releases at least 12.92 million tokens - Sep 2027
